rationale: No existing spec covers the 'Powered by OpenObserve' brand link. status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js covers the per-row dropdown gating (Post update / View updates / Custom domains), not branding; logoManagement.spec.js covers the organization logo upload on the Management page, not the status-page attribution link. The brand link is its own feature (two surfaces x two renders), so it gets its own spec in GeneralTests per the run-context spec_path. It must be registered in ci_matrix.json GeneralTests.run_files (currently neither status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js nor logoManagement.spec.js is registered there, so a new spec will not run in CI otherwise).
